integration_owned_by_root: Persist and cache-bind nonempty learning_targets while preserving legacy empty-request identities
Consume exact targets in evidence-backed coverage and bounded gap queries
Keep original complete unit text/requirements and unproven project practice separate from target coverage
Verify unknown stays unknown across original text, target ID/text, platform filtering, pending candidates and historical snapshots
frontend_route_connection: LearningCoverage must show confirmed concept targets even when a title-only or whole_topic result exists. Missing targets remain unknown; an API-name match or collection of supported subskills cannot assert complete teaching or completed project practice.
additional_nonblocking_observation: The advanced bicycle learner has Python/statistics experience but is new to pandas. The existing flat student_level=advanced still enters query wording. Future per-unit familiarity can improve recall without assuming advanced means familiarity with every library.
limits: Static adapter contract and offline tests only. Root is integrating downstream service/ranking and frontend. No new real API/search/model request or production acceptance is claimed.
